title: Prefix Instructions and Incompressible Flows
coverage: Read in full: introduction, principal theorem (Thm 1.1 / thm:sa-interleaved), analysis.tex (Lemma b-gradient, comparison Lemma b-comparison, scaling, projection, flat profiles), sheet-geometry.tex (gapped radix Lemma, curl motion Lemma, sheet-routing Lemma, realization Lemma), first-simulation.tex (interspersed-history table and the proof of the main theorem). Checks done: every reachable nonhalting configuration lies in some rule source (the top of R is always in A at main controls; C+ and C- test G or A); full source cylinders are pairwise disjoint and so are full image cylinders, including images into M(q',0) (separated by the record g_{q,h,a}; the h index is needed for this), into M(q,±), and into C±; area multipliers (1/B for instruction rules, 1 for loop and exit rules) are compensated by the normal scale; radix gaps are at least l/B^2 for prefixes of length at most 2 with odd digits and B=2K+2, and E(L)<1; control placement keeps nonhalt intervals in (1/4,3/8) and halt intervals in (5/8,3/4), with state gaps l; the curl identities curl(c x Y)=2c and curl((AY) x Y)=3AY when tr A=0, and the affine trajectory solves its ODE; during the middle stage the horizontal path is a convex combination of the endpoints; the loader stays below x1=1/2; stage heights and collars stay inside the cube and are vertically separated; mean zero follows from div(U⊗U); the energy-uniqueness argument on the torus is sound. Not audited: the alternative constructions in planes-and-histories, prefix-realizations, full-boxes, compact-reciprocal and autonomous (skimmed or unread).
main_claim: For each machine and finite input there is an effective smooth mean-zero force on T^3, periodic with period 1 for t>=1, at any fixed computable viscosity. The solution from rest is (U,0), smooth and unique in the classical periodic class, with bounded energy. The particle starting at (1/8,1/4,1/4) enters {1/2<x1<1} exactly when the machine halts.
sibling_notes: The family-376 sibling (Incompressible-Box-Transport..., rank 328) also reported no_gap_found. This paper's main theorem is self-contained: the companion shear paper is used only in later alternative sections, so there is no circular dependence for Thm 1.1.
